answer: Honest agents recover stake at epoch's nadir; attackers who mass-register fake peers forfeit everything once peers cross-attest. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity binding: each agent must lock a jade-bonded stake and solve a per-epoch cipher challenge derived from its registered key, so forging N identities costs N times the bond plus compute. This makes cheap sybil swarms economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0003's threat model.
